transcript_json.text: Section A
News report one.
t least 16 people were killed and up to 150 trapped under the rubble when a factory collapsed in an industrial area of Lahore in eastern Pakistan.
transcript_json.translation: 巴基斯坦东部拉合尔一个工业区的一家工厂倒塌，造成至少16人死亡,多达150人被困在废墟下。

translations.zh-CN: 巴基斯坦东部拉合尔一个工业区的一家工厂倒塌，造成至少16人死亡,多达150人被困在废墟下。

transcript_json.text: Formerly several stories high, no part of the building remained standing after the disaster, and hundreds of rescue workers including soldiers have been picking through concrete and bricks to find survivors.
transcript_json.translation: 这座原本 有数层高的建筑在灾难发生后没有任何部分保持竖立,数百名救援人员包括士兵一直在混凝土和砖块中搜寻 幸存者。

translations.zh-CN: 这座原本 有数层高的建筑在灾难发生后没有任何部分保持竖立,数百名救援人员包括士兵一直在混凝土和砖块中搜寻 幸存者。

transcript_json.text: Dozens have been pulled out alive.
transcript_json.translation: 已有数十人被救出。

translations.zh-CN: 已有数十人被救出。

transcript_json.text: Many more remain trapped and with heavy machinery being used, search teams were striving to ensure that no one is hurt further in the rescue operation.
transcript_json.translation: 还有更多人仍被困,由于使用了重型机械,搜救队正在努力确保在救援行动中 没有人受到进一步伤害。

translations.zh-CN: 还有更多人仍被困,由于使用了重型机械,搜救队正在努力确保在救援行动中 没有人受到进一步伤害。

transcript_json.text: It is not known what caused the collapse of the factory where plastic bags were manufactured.
transcript_json.translation: 目前尚不清楚这家生产塑料袋的工厂倒塌的原因。

translations.zh-CN: 目前尚不清楚这家生产塑料袋的工厂倒塌的原因。

transcript_json.text: But reports suggest the building was still under construction and may have suffered damage in last week's earthquake that hit Afghanistan and Pakistan, leaving hundreds dead.
transcript_json.translation: 但报道称该建筑仍在施工中,可 能在上周袭击阿富汗和巴基斯坦并造成数百人死亡的地震中受损。

translations.zh-CN: 但报道称该建筑仍在施工中,可 能在上周袭击阿富汗和巴基斯坦并造成数百人死亡的地震中受损。

hat makes a person famous?

transcript_json.text: This is a mystery that many people have carefully thought about.

translations.zh-CN: 这是许多人仔细思考过的谜题。

transcript_json.text: All kinds of myths surround the lives of well-known people.

translations.zh-CN: 各种神话围绕着知名人士的生活。

transcript_json.text: Most people are familiar with the works of William Shakespeare, one of the greatest English writers of the 16th and 17th centuries.
transcript_json.translation: 大多数人都熟悉 William Shakespeare的作品，他是16世纪和17世纪最伟大的英国作家之一。

translations.zh-CN: 大多数人都熟悉 William Shakespeare的作品，他是16世纪和17世纪最伟大的英国作家之一。

transcript_json.text: Yet how many know Shakespeare, the person, the man behind the works?
transcript_json.translation: 然而有多少人了解 Shakespeare这个人，了解作品背后的那个男人？

translations.zh-CN: 然而有多少人了解 Shakespeare这个人，了解作品背后的那个男人？

transcript_json.text: After centuries of research, scholars are still trying to discover Shakespeare's personal history.
transcript_json.translation: 经过几个世纪的研究，学者们仍在试图发现 Shakespeare的个人历史。

translations.zh-CN: 经过几个世纪的研究，学者们仍在试图发现 Shakespeare的个人历史。

transcript_json.text: It is not easily found in his writings.
transcript_json.translation: 在他的作品中不容易找到。

translations.zh-CN: 在他的作品中不容易找到。

transcript_json.text: Authors of the time could not protect their works.
transcript_json.translation: 那个时代的作者无法保护他们的作品。

translations.zh-CN: 那个时代的作者无法保护他们的作品。

transcript_json.text: An acting company, for example, could change a play if they wanted to.

translations.zh-CN: 例如，一个 剧团可以随意改编一部戏剧。

transcript_json.text: Nowadays, writers have copyrights to protect their work.

translations.zh-CN: 如今，作家拥有版权来保护他们的作品。

transcript_json.text: Many myths arose about Shakespeare.
transcript_json.translation: 关于Shakespeare出现了许多神 话。

translations.zh-CN: 关于Shakespeare出现了许多神 话。

transcript_json.text: Some said he had no formal education.
transcript_json.translation: 有人说他没有接受过正规教育。

translations.zh-CN: 有人说他没有接受过正规教育。

transcript_json.text: Others believed that he began his career by tending the horses of wealthy men.
transcript_json.translation: 其他人认为他的职业生涯始于照料富人的马匹。

translations.zh-CN: 其他人认为他的职业生涯始于照料富人的马匹。

transcript_json.text: All of these myths are interesting, but are they true?
transcript_json.translation: 所有这些神话都很有 趣，但它们是真的吗？

translations.zh-CN: 所有这些神话都很有 趣，但它们是真的吗？

transcript_json.text: Shakespeare's father was a respected man in Stratford-upon-Avon, a member of the town council.

translations.zh-CN: Shakespeare的父亲在Stratford-upon-Avon是一位受人尊敬的人，是 镇议会的成员。

transcript_json.text: He sent young William to grammar school.
transcript_json.translation: 他送年轻的William去文法学校。

translations.zh-CN: 他送年轻的William去文法学校。

transcript_json.text: Most people of Elizabethan times did not continue beyond grammar school.

transcript_json.text: So Shakespeare did have at least an average education.

translations.zh-CN: 所以Shakespeare至少接受了平均水平的教育。

transcript_json.text: Some parts of Shakespeare's life will always remain unknown.

translations.zh-CN: Shakespeare生活的某些部分将永远无法知晓。

transcript_json.text: The Great London Fire of 1666 burned many important documents that could've been a source of clues.

Scientists found sea levels are rising faster today than any time over the past 3,000 years. The sea level researchers gathered information going back 28 centuries. Their findings were released Monday by the proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
transcript_json.translation: 科学家发现，如今海平面上升的速度比过去3000年中的任何时候都快。海平面研究人员收集了可追溯至28个世纪前的信息。他们的研究结果于周一由《美国国家科学院院刊》发布。

translations.zh-CN: 科学家发现，如今海平面上升的速度比过去3000年中的任何时候都快。海平面研究人员收集了可追溯至28个世纪前的信息。他们的研究结果于周一由《美国国家科学院院刊》发布。

transcript_json.text: Robert Kopp from Rutgers University in New Jersey is the paper's lead author.
transcript_json.translation: 新泽西州罗格斯大学的罗伯特·科普是该论文的第一作者。

translations.zh-CN: 新泽西州罗格斯大学的罗伯特·科普是该论文的第一作者。

transcript_json.text: He said the 20th century rise was extraordinary when compared to the past 3,000 years, and Kopp said, "The rise over the last two decades has been even faster."
transcript_json.translation: 他说，与过去3000年相比，20世纪的海平面上升非同寻常，科普还说：“过去二十年的上升甚至更快。”

translations.zh-CN: 他说，与过去3000年相比，20世纪的海平面上升非同寻常，科普还说：“过去二十年的上升甚至更快。”

transcript_json.text: When temperatures rise, so do sea levels.
transcript_json.translation: 当气温上升时，海平面也随之上升。

translations.zh-CN: 当气温上升时，海平面也随之上升。

transcript_json.text: That is because snow and ice melt or break off from glaciers.
transcript_json.translation: 这是因为冰雪融化或从冰川上断裂。

translations.zh-CN: 这是因为冰雪融化或从冰川上断裂。

transcript_json.text: They flow into the sea.
transcript_json.translation: 它们流入大海。

translations.zh-CN: 它们流入大海。

transcript_json.text: The increased water makes the sea levels rise.
transcript_json.translation: 增加的水量使海平面上升。

translations.zh-CN: 增加的水量使海平面上升。

transcript_json.text: The best estimates show that temperatures around the earth have risen more than a half degree Celsius since 1880.
transcript_json.translation: 最可靠的估计显示，自1880年以来，全球气温上升了超过半摄氏度。

translations.zh-CN: 最可靠的估计显示，自1880年以来，全球气温上升了超过半摄氏度。

transcript_json.text: Scientists say that most of that rise is because of emissions or gases released into the air by machines that humans have built.
transcript_json.translation: 科学家说，其中大部分上升是由人类建造的机器排放到空气中的气体造成的。

translations.zh-CN: 科学家说，其中大部分上升是由人类建造的机器排放到空气中的气体造成的。

transcript_json.text: And it is not going to get better.
transcript_json.translation: 而且情况不会好转。

translations.zh-CN: 而且情况不会好转。

transcript_json.text: The water is going to rise, said Stefan Hamstorff.
transcript_json.translation: 水位将会上升，斯特凡·拉姆斯托夫说。

translations.zh-CN: 水位将会上升，斯特凡·拉姆斯托夫说。

transcript_json.text: He is a professor of ocean physics at the Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research in Germany, and the studies co-author.
transcript_json.translation: 他是德国波茨坦气候影响研究所的海洋物理学教授，也是该研究的合著者。

translations.zh-CN: 他是德国波茨坦气候影响研究所的海洋物理学教授，也是该研究的合著者。

transcript_json.text: Landfills are places to dump waste, but they are unpopular because they can pollute the soil used to cover them and that's bad for people who may build new homes there.

transcript_json.text: Recycling also reuses valuable raw materials such as aluminum and paper.
transcript_json.translation: 回收利用还能重复使用铝和纸 张等宝贵的原材料。

translations.zh-CN: 回收利用还能重复使用铝和纸 张等宝贵的原材料。

transcript_json.text: Finally recycling can leave a lower garbage bill.
transcript_json.translation: 最后,回收利用可以降低垃圾处理费用。

translations.zh-CN: 最后,回收利用可以降低垃圾处理费用。

transcript_json.text: Recycling lowers the amount of waste put into landfills.
transcript_json.translation: 回收利用减少了送往垃圾填埋场的废物量,因 此垃圾处理的花费就更少了。

transcript_json.text: Therefore less money is spent for garbage disposal.

transcript_json.text: W: How has recycling changed over the years?

translations.zh-CN: W: 这些年来回收利用发生了怎样的变化？

transcript_json.text: M: 10 or 20 years ago, you could buy milk in returnable, refillable glass bottles and many people recycled voluntarily.
transcript_json.translation: 10年或20年前,你可以买装在可回收、可重复使用玻璃瓶里的牛奶,很多人会自愿回收。

transcript_json.translation: M: 回收利用主要通过节约能源来帮助环境。

transcript_json.text: For example it takes 95% less energy to produce recycled aluminum than to produce new aluminum.
transcript_json.translation: 例如，生产再生铝比生产新铝少消耗95%的能源。

transcript_json.text: M: If not you then who?

hat makes a person famous?

transcript_json.text: This is a mystery that many people have carefully thought about.
transcript_json.translation: 这是许多人仔细思考过的一个谜。

translations.zh-CN: 这是许多人仔细思考过的一个谜。

transcript_json.text: All kinds of myths surround the lives of well-known people.
transcript_json.translation: 各种各样的传说围绕着知名人士的生活。

translations.zh-CN: 各种各样的传说围绕着知名人士的生活。

transcript_json.text: Most people are familiar with the works of William Shakespeare, one of the greatest English writers of the 16th and 17th centuries.
transcript_json.translation: 大多数 人都熟悉William Shakespeare的作品，他是16世纪和17世纪最伟大的英国作家之一。

translations.zh-CN: 大多数 人都熟悉William Shakespeare的作品，他是16世纪和17世纪最伟大的英国作家之一。

transcript_json.text: Yet how many know Shakespeare, the person, the man behind the works?
transcript_json.translation: 然而有多少人了解 Shakespeare这个人，了解作品背后的那个男人？

translations.zh-CN: 然而有多少人了解 Shakespeare这个人，了解作品背后的那个男人？

transcript_json.text: After centuries of research, scholars are still trying to discover Shakespeare's personal history.
transcript_json.translation: 经过几个世纪的研究，学者们仍在试图发现 Shakespeare的个人历史。

translations.zh-CN: 经过几个世纪的研究，学者们仍在试图发现 Shakespeare的个人历史。

transcript_json.text: It is not easily found in his writings.
transcript_json.translation: 在他的作品中不容易找到这些信息。

translations.zh-CN: 在他的作品中不容易找到这些信息。

transcript_json.text: Authors of the time could not protect their works.
transcript_json.translation: 当时的作者无法保护自己的作品。

translations.zh-CN: 当时的作者无法保护自己的作品。

transcript_json.text: An acting company, for example, could change a play if they wanted to.
transcript_json.translation: 例如， 一个剧团可以随意修改剧本。

translations.zh-CN: 例如， 一个剧团可以随意修改剧本。

transcript_json.text: Nowadays, writers have copyrights to protect their work.
transcript_json.translation: 如今，作家拥有版权来保护他们的作品。

translations.zh-CN: 如今，作家拥有版权来保护他们的作品。

transcript_json.text: Many myths arose about Shakespeare.
transcript_json.translation: 关于Shakespeare产生了许多传 说。

translations.zh-CN: 关于Shakespeare产生了许多传 说。

transcript_json.text: Some said he had no formal education.
transcript_json.translation: 有人说他没有受过正规教育。

translations.zh-CN: 有人说他没有受过正规教育。

transcript_json.text: Others believed that he began his career by tending the horses of wealthy men.
transcript_json.translation: 还有人认为他的职业生涯始于为富人看马。

translations.zh-CN: 还有人认为他的职业生涯始于为富人看马。

transcript_json.text: All of these myths are interesting, but are they true?
transcript_json.translation: 所有这些传说都很有趣，但 它们是真的吗？

translations.zh-CN: 所有这些传说都很有趣，但 它们是真的吗？

transcript_json.text: Shakespeare's father was a respected man in Stratford-upon-Avon, a member of the town council.
transcript_json.translation: Shakespeare的父亲是Stratford-upon-Avon一位受人尊敬的人，是镇议会的 成员。

translations.zh-CN: Shakespeare的父亲是Stratford-upon-Avon一位受人尊敬的人，是镇议会的 成员。

transcript_json.text: He sent young William to grammar school.
transcript_json.translation: 他送年轻的William去文法学校读书。

translations.zh-CN: 他送年轻的William去文法学校读书。

transcript_json.text: Most people of Elizabethan times did not continue beyond grammar school.
transcript_json.translation: 伊丽莎白时代的大多数人不会继续接受文法学校以上的教 育。

translations.zh-CN: 伊丽莎白时代的大多数人不会继续接受文法学校以上的教 育。

transcript_json.text: So Shakespeare did have at least an average education.
transcript_json.translation: 所以Shakespeare确实至少受过普通教育。

translations.zh-CN: 所以Shakespeare确实至少受过普通教育。

transcript_json.text: Some parts of Shakespeare's life will always remain unknown.
transcript_json.translation: Shakespeare生活的某些部分将永远不为人知。

translations.zh-CN: Shakespeare生活的某些部分将永远不为人知。

transcript_json.text: The Great London Fire of 1666 burned many important documents that could've been a source of clues.
transcript_json.translation: 1666年 的伦敦大火烧毁了许多重要文献，这些文献本可以成为线索的来源。

translations.zh-CN: 1666年 的伦敦大火烧毁了许多重要文献，这些文献本可以成为线索的来源。

transcript_json.text: We'll always be left with many questions and few facts.
transcript_json.translation: 我们将永远面对许多问题和很少的 事实。

translations.zh-CN: 我们将永远面对许多问题和很少的 事实。

Almost everyone suffers from a headache occasionally, but some people suffer from repeated, frequent headaches
transcript_json.translation: 几乎每个人偶尔都会头痛，但有些人会反复、频繁地头痛。

translations.zh-CN: 几乎每个人偶尔都会头痛，但有些人会反复、频繁地头痛。

transcript_json.text: A headache is important because it can be the first warning of a serious condition that could probably be controlled if discovered early.
transcript_json.translation: 头痛之所以重要，是因为它可能是某种严重病症的第一道警告，如果及早发现，这种病症或许是可以控制的。

translations.zh-CN: 头痛之所以重要，是因为它可能是某种严重病症的第一道警告，如果及早发现，这种病症或许是可以控制的。

transcript_json.text: If a person removes the warning day after day with a painkiller, he or she may pass the point of easy control.
transcript_json.translation: 如果一个人日复一日地用止痛药消除这一警告，他或她可能就会错过容易控制的时机。

translations.zh-CN: 如果一个人日复一日地用止痛药消除这一警告，他或她可能就会错过容易控制的时机。

transcript_json.text: The professional name for covering up a symptom is masking.
transcript_json.translation: 掩盖症状的专业术语叫作“掩盖”。

translations.zh-CN: 掩盖症状的专业术语叫作“掩盖”。

transcript_json.text: A headache specialist once said, "Masking symptoms is not the best way of treatment.
transcript_json.translation: 一位头痛专家曾说：“掩盖症状并不是最好的治疗方式。

translations.zh-CN: 一位头痛专家曾说：“掩盖症状并不是最好的治疗方式。

transcript_json.text: Sometimes it is wiser to stand still than to advance in darkness.
transcript_json.translation: 有时，原地不动比在黑暗中前行更明智。”

translations.zh-CN: 有时，原地不动比在黑暗中前行更明智。”

transcript_json.text: A headache often interferes needlessly with normal, happy living.
transcript_json.translation: 头痛常常不必要地干扰正常、快乐的生活。

translations.zh-CN: 头痛常常不必要地干扰正常、快乐的生活。

transcript_json.text: The employee with a headache does less work.
transcript_json.translation: 头痛的员工工作做得更少。

translations.zh-CN: 头痛的员工工作做得更少。

transcript_json.text: In a flash of temper, he or she may upset fellow workers or customers, causing a direct or indirect loss to the organization.
transcript_json.translation: 一怒之下，他或她可能会惹恼同事或顾客，给组织造成直接或间接的损失。

translations.zh-CN: 一怒之下，他或她可能会惹恼同事或顾客，给组织造成直接或间接的损失。

transcript_json.text: The mother with a headache suffers and disturbs the family.
transcript_json.translation: 头痛的母亲既自己难受，又扰乱了家庭。

translations.zh-CN: 头痛的母亲既自己难受，又扰乱了家庭。

transcript_json.text: She upsets her husband and children.
transcript_json.translation: 她让丈夫和孩子心烦。

translations.zh-CN: 她让丈夫和孩子心烦。

transcript_json.text: Rest, quiet, and fresh air stop many common headaches.
transcript_json.translation: 休息、安静和新鲜空气能止住许多常见的头痛。

translations.zh-CN: 休息、安静和新鲜空气能止住许多常见的头痛。

transcript_json.text: Lying down and possibly falling asleep may help.
transcript_json.translation: 躺下，甚至可能睡着，都会有帮助。

translations.zh-CN: 躺下，甚至可能睡着，都会有帮助。

transcript_json.text: One can often handle tension headaches by rubbing and pressing the neck muscles.

transcript_json.text: Heat from an electric pad or a warm bath can also help.

transcript_json.text: Because hunger may be overlooked as a headache source, one must make a habit of regular meals.
transcript_json.translation: 由于饥饿作为头痛的一个原因可能被忽视，人们必须养成规律进餐的习惯。

News report 2.
Millions of bees have died in South Carolina during aerial insect spraying operations that were carried out to combat the Zika virus
transcript_json.translation: 在南卡罗来纳州，为抗击寨卡病毒而进行的空中喷洒杀虫剂作业导致数百万只蜜蜂死亡。

translations.zh-CN: 在南卡罗来纳州，为抗击寨卡病毒而进行的空中喷洒杀虫剂作业导致数百万只蜜蜂死亡。

transcript_json.text: The insect spraying over the weekend left more than two million bees dead on the spot in Dorchester County, South Carolina, where four travel-related cases of Zika disease have been confirmed in the area.
transcript_json.translation: 周末的杀虫剂喷洒导致南卡罗来纳州多切斯特县两百多万只蜜蜂当场死亡，该地区已确诊四例与旅行相关的寨卡病例。

translations.zh-CN: 周末的杀虫剂喷洒导致南卡罗来纳州多切斯特县两百多万只蜜蜂当场死亡，该地区已确诊四例与旅行相关的寨卡病例。

transcript_json.text: Most of the deaths came from Flowertown Bee Farm, a company in Somerville that sells bees and honey products.
transcript_json.translation: 大多数死亡来自“花城蜂场”，这是萨默维尔一家销售蜜蜂和蜂蜜产品的公司。

translations.zh-CN: 大多数死亡来自“花城蜂场”，这是萨默维尔一家销售蜜蜂和蜂蜜产品的公司。

transcript_json.text: Juanita Stanley, who owns the company, said the farm looks like it's been destroyed.
transcript_json.translation: 公司老板胡安妮塔·斯坦利说，蜂场看起来像是被毁了。

translations.zh-CN: 公司老板胡安妮塔·斯坦利说，蜂场看起来像是被毁了。

transcript_json.text: The farm lost about 2.5 million bees.
transcript_json.translation: 这家蜂场损失了约250万只蜜蜂。

translations.zh-CN: 这家蜂场损失了约250万只蜜蜂。

transcript_json.text: Dorchester County officials apologized for the accidental mass killing of bees.
transcript_json.translation: 多切斯特县官员为这起意外的大规模蜜蜂死亡事件道歉。

translations.zh-CN: 多切斯特县官员为这起意外的大规模蜜蜂死亡事件道歉。

transcript_json.text: Dorchester County is aware that some beekeepers in the area that was sprayed on Sunday lost their bee colonies.
transcript_json.translation: 多切斯特县了解到，周日喷洒区域内的一些养蜂人失去了他们的蜂群。

translations.zh-CN: 多切斯特县了解到，周日喷洒区域内的一些养蜂人失去了他们的蜂群。

transcript_json.text: County manager Jason Ward said in a statement, "I'm not pleased that so many bees were killed."
transcript_json.translation: 县长贾森·沃德在一份声明中说：“这么多蜜蜂死亡，我并不高兴。”

translations.zh-CN: 县长贾森·沃德在一份声明中说：“这么多蜜蜂死亡，我并不高兴。”

News report 3.
The world's largest aircraft has taken to the skies for the first time. The Air Lander 10 spent nearly two hours in the air, having taken off from Cardington Airfield in Bedfordshire
transcript_json.translation: 世界上最大的飞行器首次升空。“天空登陆者10号”从贝德福德郡的卡丁顿机场起飞，在空中飞行了近两个小时。

translations.zh-CN: 世界上最大的飞行器首次升空。“天空登陆者10号”从贝德福德郡的卡丁顿机场起飞，在空中飞行了近两个小时。

transcript_json.text: During its flight, it reached 3,000 feet and performed a series of gentle turns all over a safe area.
transcript_json.translation: 飞行期间，它达到3000英尺的高度，并在一片安全区域上空完成了一系列平缓的转向。

translations.zh-CN: 飞行期间，它达到3000英尺的高度，并在一片安全区域上空完成了一系列平缓的转向。

transcript_json.text: The aircraft is massive as long as a football field and as tall as six double-decker buses and capable of flying for up to five days.
transcript_json.translation: 这架飞行器体型巨大，长度相当于一个足球场，高度相当于六辆双层巴士，能够连续飞行长达五天。

translations.zh-CN: 这架飞行器体型巨大，长度相当于一个足球场，高度相当于六辆双层巴士，能够连续飞行长达五天。

transcript_json.text: It was first developed for the US government as a long-range spy aircraft, but was abandoned following budget cutbacks.
transcript_json.translation: 它最初是为美国政府研发的远程侦察飞行器，但因预算削减而被放弃。

translations.zh-CN: 它最初是为美国政府研发的远程侦察飞行器，但因预算削减而被放弃。

transcript_json.text: The aircraft cost £25 million and can carry heavier loads than huge jet planes, while also producing less noise and emitting less pollution.
transcript_json.translation: 这架飞行器造价2500万英镑，能比巨型喷气式飞机运载更重的货物，同时噪音更小、污染更少。

translations.zh-CN: 这架飞行器造价2500万英镑，能比巨型喷气式飞机运载更重的货物，同时噪音更小、污染更少。

transcript_json.text: The makers believe it's the future of aircraft and one day we'll be using them to go places.
transcript_json.translation: 制造商相信它代表着飞行器的未来，总有一天我们会乘坐它出行。

translations.zh-CN: 制造商相信它代表着飞行器的未来，总有一天我们会乘坐它出行。

transcript_json.text: But there's still a long way to go.
transcript_json.translation: 但还有很长的路要走。

translations.zh-CN: 但还有很长的路要走。

transcript_json.text: The Air Lander will need to have 200 hours flying time before being allowed to fly by the aviation administration.
transcript_json.translation: “天空登陆者”需要累计200小时的飞行时间，才能获得航空管理部门的飞行许可。

translations.zh-CN: “天空登陆者”需要累计200小时的飞行时间，才能获得航空管理部门的飞行许可。

transcript_json.text: If it passes though, we can hope we'll all get some extra leg room.
transcript_json.translation: 不过如果它通过了，我们就可以期待以后都能有更宽敞的伸腿空间。

translations.zh-CN: 不过如果它通过了，我们就可以期待以后都能有更宽敞的伸腿空间。

ave you ever felt like you would do just about anything to satisfy your hunger?
transcript_json.translation: 你是否曾经觉得为了满足饥饿感几乎什么都愿意做？

translations.zh-CN: 你是否曾经觉得为了满足饥饿感几乎什么都愿意做？

transcript_json.text: A new study in mice may help to explain why hunger can feel like such a powerful motivating force.
transcript_json.translation: 一项针对小鼠的新研究可能有助于解释为什么饥饿会 让人感觉像是一种如此强大的驱动力量。

translations.zh-CN: 一项针对小鼠的新研究可能有助于解释为什么饥饿会 让人感觉像是一种如此强大的驱动力量。

transcript_json.text: In the study, researchers found that hunger outweighed other physical drives, including fear, thirst and social needs.
transcript_json.translation: 在这项研究中，研究人员发现饥饿胜过其他生理驱动力，包括恐 惧、口渴和社交需求。

translations.zh-CN: 在这项研究中，研究人员发现饥饿胜过其他生理驱动力，包括恐 惧、口渴和社交需求。

transcript_json.text: To determine which feeling won out, the researchers did a series of experiments.
transcript_json.translation: 为了确定哪种感觉会占上风，研究人员进行了一系列实验。

translations.zh-CN: 为了确定哪种感觉会占上风，研究人员进行了一系列实验。

transcript_json.text: In one experiment, the mice were both hungry and thirsty.
transcript_json.translation: 在一项实验中，小鼠既 饥饿又口渴。

translations.zh-CN: 在一项实验中，小鼠既 饥饿又口渴。

transcript_json.text: When given the choice of either eating food or drinking water, the mice went for the food, the researchers found.
transcript_json.translation: 研究人员发现，当给予小鼠进食或饮水的选择时，小鼠选择了食物。

translations.zh-CN: 研究人员发现，当给予小鼠进食或饮水的选择时，小鼠选择了食物。

transcript_json.text: However, when the mice were well-fed but thirsty, they opted to drink, according to the study.
transcript_json.translation: 然而，根据该研究，当 小鼠吃饱但口渴时，它们选择了饮水。

translations.zh-CN: 然而，根据该研究，当 小鼠吃饱但口渴时，它们选择了饮水。

transcript_json.text: In the second experiment meant to pit the mice's hunger against their fear, hungry mice were placed in a cage that had certain "fox-scented" areas and other places that smelled safer (in other words, not like an animal that could eat them) but also had food.
transcript_json.translation: 在第二项旨在让小鼠的饥饿与恐惧相对抗的实验中，饥饿的小鼠被 放置在一个笼子里，笼子里有某些带有"狐狸气味"的区域和其他闻起来更安全的地方（换句话说，不像能 吃掉它们的动物），但也有食物。

translations.zh-CN: 在第二项旨在让小鼠的饥饿与恐惧相对抗的实验中，饥饿的小鼠被 放置在一个笼子里，笼子里有某些带有"狐狸气味"的区域和其他闻起来更安全的地方（换句话说，不像能 吃掉它们的动物），但也有食物。

transcript_json.text: It turned out that, when the mice were hungry, they ventured into the unsafe areas for food.
transcript_json.translation: 结果表明，当小鼠饥饿时，它们会冒险进入不安全的区域寻找食物。

translations.zh-CN: 结果表明，当小鼠饥饿时，它们会冒险进入不安全的区域寻找食物。

transcript_json.text: But when the mice were well-fed, they stayed in areas of the cage that were considered "safe.
transcript_json.translation: 但 当小鼠吃饱时，它们会待在笼子中被认为"安全"的区域。

translations.zh-CN: 但 当小鼠吃饱时，它们会待在笼子中被认为"安全"的区域。

transcript_json.text: Hunger also outweighed the mice's social needs, the researchers found.
transcript_json.translation: 研究人员发现，饥饿也胜过了小鼠的社交需求。

translations.zh-CN: 研究人员发现，饥饿也胜过了小鼠的社交需求。

transcript_json.text: Mice are usually social animals and prefer to be in the company of other mice, according to the study.
transcript_json.translation: 根据该研究，小鼠通常是社交性动物，喜欢与其他小鼠作伴。

translations.zh-CN: 根据该研究，小鼠通常是社交性动物，喜欢与其他小鼠作伴。

transcript_json.text: When the mice were hungry, they opted to leave the company of other mice to go get food.
transcript_json.translation: 当小鼠饥饿时，它们选择离开其他小鼠的陪 伴去获取食物。

translations.zh-CN: 当小鼠饥饿时，它们选择离开其他小鼠的陪 伴去获取食物。

Passage 2.
The United States has one of the best highway systems in the world.
transcript_json.translation: 美国拥有世界上最好的公路系统之一。

translations.zh-CN: 美国拥有世界上最好的公路系统之一。

transcript_json.text: Interstate highways connect just about every large and mid-sized city in the country.
transcript_json.translation: 州际公路几乎连接了全国每一座大中城市。

translations.zh-CN: 州际公路几乎连接了全国每一座大中城市。

transcript_json.text: Did you ever wonder why such a complete system of excellent roads exists?
transcript_json.translation: 你是否想过，为什么会有如此完善的优质公路系统？

translations.zh-CN: 你是否想过，为什么会有如此完善的优质公路系统？

transcript_json.text: For an answer, you would have to go back to the early 1920s.
transcript_json.translation: 要找到答案，得追溯到20世纪20年代初。

translations.zh-CN: 要找到答案，得追溯到20世纪20年代初。

transcript_json.text: In those years, just after World War I, the military wanted to build an American highway system for national defence.
transcript_json.translation: 在那些年里，也就是第一次世界大战刚结束后，军方希望修建一套用于国防的美国公路系统。

translations.zh-CN: 在那些年里，也就是第一次世界大战刚结束后，军方希望修建一套用于国防的美国公路系统。

transcript_json.text: Such a system could, if necessary, move troops quickly from one area to another.
transcript_json.translation: 这样的系统在必要时可以把部队迅速从一个地区调往另一个地区。

translations.zh-CN: 这样的系统在必要时可以把部队迅速从一个地区调往另一个地区。

transcript_json.text: It could also get people out of cities in danger of being bombed.
transcript_json.translation: 它还能让人们撤离可能遭到轰炸的城市。

translations.zh-CN: 它还能让人们撤离可能遭到轰炸的城市。

transcript_json.text: So-called 'roads of national importance' were designated, but they were mostly bombed.
transcript_json.translation: 所谓的“国家重要道路”被指定出来，但它们大多被轰炸了。

translations.zh-CN: 所谓的“国家重要道路”被指定出来，但它们大多被轰炸了。

transcript_json.text: In 1944, Congress passed a bill to upgrade the system, but did not fund the plan right away.
transcript_json.translation: 1944年，国会通过了一项升级该系统的法案，但并没有立即为计划拨款。

translations.zh-CN: 1944年，国会通过了一项升级该系统的法案，但并没有立即为计划拨款。

transcript_json.text: In the 1950s, the plan began to become a reality.
transcript_json.translation: 20世纪50年代，这一计划开始成为现实。

translations.zh-CN: 20世纪50年代，这一计划开始成为现实。

transcript_json.text: Over $25 billion was appropriated by Congress, and construction began on about 40,000 miles of new roads.
transcript_json.translation: 国会拨款超过250亿美元，约4万英里的新道路开始动工。

translations.zh-CN: 国会拨款超过250亿美元，约4万英里的新道路开始动工。

transcript_json.text: The idea was to connect the new system to existing expressways and freeways.
transcript_json.translation: 其构想是把新系统与现有的快速路和高速公路连接起来。

translations.zh-CN: 其构想是把新系统与现有的快速路和高速公路连接起来。

transcript_json.text: And, though the system was built mostly to make car travel easier, defence was not forgotten.
transcript_json.translation: 而且，尽管该系统主要是为了让汽车出行更方便而修建的，国防需求也没有被遗忘。

translations.zh-CN: 而且，尽管该系统主要是为了让汽车出行更方便而修建的，国防需求也没有被遗忘。

transcript_json.text: For instance, highway overpasses had to be high enough to allow trailers carrying military missiles to pass under them.
transcript_json.translation: 例如，公路立交桥必须足够高，以便运载军用导弹的拖车能从下面通过。

translations.zh-CN: 例如，公路立交桥必须足够高，以便运载军用导弹的拖车能从下面通过。

transcript_json.text: By 1974, the system was mostly completed.
transcript_json.translation: 到1974年，该系统大体完工。

translations.zh-CN: 到1974年，该系统大体完工。

transcript_json.text: A few additional roads would come later.
transcript_json.translation: 还有一些额外的道路后来才修建。

translations.zh-CN: 还有一些额外的道路后来才修建。

transcript_json.text: Quick and easy travel between all parts of the country was now possible.
transcript_json.translation: 如今，在全国各地之间快速便捷地出行成为可能。

translations.zh-CN: 如今，在全国各地之间快速便捷地出行成为可能。

Texting while driving was listed as a major cause of road deaths among young Americans back in 2013
transcript_json.translation: 早在2013年，开车时发短信就被列为美国年轻人道路死亡的主要原因之一。

translations.zh-CN: 早在2013年，开车时发短信就被列为美国年轻人道路死亡的主要原因之一。

transcript_json.text: A recent study said that 40% of American teens claimed to have been in a car when the driver used a cell phone in a way that put people in danger.
transcript_json.translation: 最近一项研究称，40%的美国青少年表示自己曾坐在车里，而司机使用手机的方式让人处于危险之中。

translations.zh-CN: 最近一项研究称，40%的美国青少年表示自己曾坐在车里，而司机使用手机的方式让人处于危险之中。

transcript_json.text: This sounds like a widespread disease, but it's one that technology may now help to cure.
transcript_json.translation: 这听起来像是一种广泛传播的疾病，但如今技术或许能帮助治愈它。

translations.zh-CN: 这听起来像是一种广泛传播的疾病，但如今技术或许能帮助治愈它。

transcript_json.text: TJ Everts, a 20-year-old inventor, has come up with a novel solution that could easily put texting drivers on notice.
transcript_json.translation: 20岁的发明家TJ·埃弗茨想出了一个新颖的解决方案，可以轻松地提醒发短信的司机。

translations.zh-CN: 20岁的发明家TJ·埃弗茨想出了一个新颖的解决方案，可以轻松地提醒发短信的司机。

transcript_json.text: It's called Smart Wheel, and it's designed to fit over the steering wheel of most standard vehicles to track whether or not the driver has two hands on the wheel at all times.
transcript_json.translation: 它叫“智能方向盘”，设计用于套在大多数标准车辆的方向盘上，以追踪司机是否始终双手握方向盘。

translations.zh-CN: 它叫“智能方向盘”，设计用于套在大多数标准车辆的方向盘上，以追踪司机是否始终双手握方向盘。

transcript_json.text: Everts' invention warns the drivers with a light and a sound when they hold the wheel with one hand only, but as soon as they place the other hand back on the wheel, the light turns back to green and the sound stops.
transcript_json.translation: 当司机只用一只手握方向盘时，埃弗茨的发明会用灯光和声音发出警告，但一旦他们把另一只手放回方向盘，灯光就会变回绿色，声音也会停止。

translations.zh-CN: 当司机只用一只手握方向盘时，埃弗茨的发明会用灯光和声音发出警告，但一旦他们把另一只手放回方向盘，灯光就会变回绿色，声音也会停止。

transcript_json.text: It also watches for what's called close by hands, where both hands are close together near the top of the wheel so the driver can type with both thumbs and drive at the same time.
transcript_json.translation: 它还会监测所谓的“双手靠近”，即两只手都靠近方向盘顶部，这样司机就能一边用两个拇指打字一边开车。

translations.zh-CN: 它还会监测所谓的“双手靠近”，即两只手都靠近方向盘顶部，这样司机就能一边用两个拇指打字一边开车。

transcript_json.text: All the data Smart Wheel collects is also sent to a connected app, so any parents who install Smart Wheel can keep track of the teen's driving habits.
transcript_json.translation: “智能方向盘”收集的所有数据还会发送到一个连接的应用程序，因此任何安装了“智能方向盘”的父母都能追踪青少年的驾驶习惯。

translations.zh-CN: “智能方向盘”收集的所有数据还会发送到一个连接的应用程序，因此任何安装了“智能方向盘”的父母都能追踪青少年的驾驶习惯。

transcript_json.text: If they try to remove or damage the cover, that's reported as well.
transcript_json.translation: 如果他们试图拆下或损坏这个套件，也会被报告。

translations.zh-CN: 如果他们试图拆下或损坏这个套件，也会被报告。

News Report 1.

elly Swisher, an Arkansas woman, escaped injury and managed to safely stop her car after a 4-foot- long rat snake came out from under her car seat and slid across her feet as she was driving down the highway.
transcript_json.translation: Arkansas州女子Kelly Swisher在高速公路上驾车时，一条4英尺长的鼠蛇从她的座位下爬出并滑过她的脚 面，她成功避免受伤并安全停车。

translations.zh-CN: Arkansas州女子Kelly Swisher在高速公路上驾车时，一条4英尺长的鼠蛇从她的座位下爬出并滑过她的脚 面，她成功避免受伤并安全停车。

transcript_json.text: Rat snakes aren't poisonous or a threat to people generally.
transcript_json.translation: 鼠蛇通常没有毒性，对人也不构成威胁。

translations.zh-CN: 鼠蛇通常没有毒性，对人也不构成威胁。

transcript_json.text: But the woman says the snake she encountered Thursday terrified her out of her wits.
transcript_json.translation: 但这名女子说，她周四遇到的 这条蛇把她吓得魂飞魄散。

translations.zh-CN: 但这名女子说，她周四遇到的 这条蛇把她吓得魂飞魄散。

transcript_json.text: "It was rough, with big scales," said Swisher, who was on her way to pick up her friend at the airport when it happened.
transcript_json.translation: "它很粗糙，鳞片很大，"Swisher说，事发时她正在去机场接朋友的路上。

translations.zh-CN: "它很粗糙，鳞片很大，"Swisher说，事发时她正在去机场接朋友的路上。

transcript_json.text: "I don't know whether I had my hands on the steering wheel or not.
transcript_json.translation: "我 不知道我的手是否还在方向盘上。

translations.zh-CN: "我 不知道我的手是否还在方向盘上。

transcript_json.text: I am not the most flexible person in the world, but I can guarantee my knees were up next to my ears.
transcript_json.translation: 我不是世界上最灵活的人，但我可以保证我的膝盖都顶到耳朵旁边 了。

A savanna cat is a crossbreed between a domestic cat and a medium-sized wild African cat called the serval
The unusual cross became popular among breeders at the end of the 1990s, and in 2001 the International Cat Association accepted it as a new registered breed.
The savannas are tall and slim, and can weigh up to 9.1 kilograms, making them one of the largest breeds of cats that people can own.
They have a spotted coat similar to that of many types of wild cats, and their ears are very large.

cientists have identified thousands of known ant species around the world—and only a few of them bug humans.

translations.zh-CN: 大多数蚂蚁生活在树林 或自然环境中。

transcript_json.text: There, they keep other creatures in check, distribute seeds, and clean dead and decaying materials from the ground.

transcript_json.text: A very small percentage of ants do harm to humans.
transcript_json.translation: 只有极小比 例的蚂蚁会对人类造成危害。

translations.zh-CN: 只有极小比 例的蚂蚁会对人类造成危害。

transcript_json.text: But those are incredibly challenging to control.
transcript_json.translation: 但这些蚂蚁极难控制。

translations.zh-CN: 但这些蚂蚁极难控制。

transcript_json.text: They are small enough to easily slip inside your house, live in colonies that number in the tens of thousands to the hundreds of thousands, and reproduce quickly.
transcript_json.translation: 它们体型小到足以轻易溜进你的房子,生活在数量达数 万到数十万只的群体中,且繁殖迅速。

transcript_json.text: That makes them good at getting in, and hard to kick out.
transcript_json.translation: 这使得它们善于入侵,却难以驱逐。

transcript_json.text: Once they settle in, these insects start affecting your home.

transcript_json.text: Some, like carpenter ants, can undermine a home's structure, while others interfere with electrical units.

transcript_json.text: So how can we prevent ants from getting into our homes?

My research focus is on what happens to our immune system as we age. So the job of the immune system is to fight infections. It also protects us from viruses and from autoimmune diseases

ingle-sex education can have enormous benefits for female students.

transcript_json.text: Numerous studies have shown that women who attend single-sex schools tend to have stronger self-confidence, better study habits and more ambitious career goals than women who attend coeducational schools.

transcript_json.text: Girls who graduate from single-sex schools are three times more likely to become engineers than those who attend coeducational schools.

transcript_json.text: The reason is that all-girls schools encourage women to enter fields traditionally dominated by men, such as science, technology and engineering.

transcript_json.text: In coeducational schools, girls are often expected to succeed only in humanities or the arts.

transcript_json.text: Research has also shown that in coeducational settings, teachers are more likely to praise and give in-depth responses to a boy's comments in class.

transcript_json.text: In contrast, they might only respond to a girl's comments with a nod.
transcript_json.translation: 相比之下，他们可能只是点头回应女生 的评论。

translations.zh-CN: 相比之下，他们可能只是点头回应女生 的评论。

transcript_json.text: They are also more likely to encourage boys to work through problems on their own, while they tend to step in and help girls who struggle with a problem.
transcript_json.translation: 他们也更倾向于鼓励男生独立解决问题，而往往会介入帮助遇到困难的女生。

translations.zh-CN: 他们也更倾向于鼓励男生独立解决问题，而往往会介入帮助遇到困难的女生。

transcript_json.text: In an all-girls setting, girls are more likely to speak up frequently and make significant contributions to class than in a coeducational setting.
transcript_json.translation: 在全女生环境中， 女生比在男女同校环境中更有可能频繁发言并对课堂做出重要贡献。

translations.zh-CN: 在全女生环境中， 女生比在男女同校环境中更有可能频繁发言并对课堂做出重要贡献。

transcript_json.text: Girls studying in a single-sex setting also earn higher scores on their College Board and Advanced Placement exams than girls who study in coeducational settings.

transcript_json.text: All-girls schools tend to be smaller than coeducational schools, which means teachers will be able to tailor the materials to girl students' personal learning styles and interest.

Passage 3.
After a tough workout or a day full of physical activity, it's common to find your muscles aching. But where do these pains come from?
transcript_json.translation: 在一次艰苦的锻炼或充满体力活动的一天之后，发现肌肉酸痛是很常见的。但这些疼痛从何而来？

translations.zh-CN: 在一次艰苦的锻炼或充满体力活动的一天之后，发现肌肉酸痛是很常见的。但这些疼痛从何而来？

transcript_json.text: According to a German professor, the soreness comes from straining your muscles in an uncommon way, for example, jumping on a bicycle for a ride.
transcript_json.translation: 据一位德国教授说，酸痛来自于以不常见的方式使肌肉紧张，例如，跳上自行车骑行。

translations.zh-CN: 据一位德国教授说，酸痛来自于以不常见的方式使肌肉紧张，例如，跳上自行车骑行。

transcript_json.text: Because you haven't ridden in a long time, soreness occurs since your leg muscles aren't used to that movement.
transcript_json.translation: 因为你很久没骑车了，所以会出现酸痛，因为你的腿部肌肉不习惯那种动作。

translations.zh-CN: 因为你很久没骑车了，所以会出现酸痛，因为你的腿部肌肉不习惯那种动作。

transcript_json.text: When muscles perform an activity they aren't regularly exposed to.
transcript_json.translation: 当肌肉进行它们不经常接触的活动时。

translations.zh-CN: 当肌肉进行它们不经常接触的活动时。

transcript_json.text: The tiny fibres that are inside them are being torn apart.
transcript_json.translation: 它们内部的微小纤维会被撕裂。

translations.zh-CN: 它们内部的微小纤维会被撕裂。

transcript_json.text: As muscle soreness develops, the body has to work to repair the muscle tears.
transcript_json.translation: 随着肌肉酸痛的发展，身体必须努力修复肌肉撕裂。

translations.zh-CN: 随着肌肉酸痛的发展，身体必须努力修复肌肉撕裂。

transcript_json.text: But this doesn't happen immediately.
transcript_json.translation: 但这不会立即发生。

translations.zh-CN: 但这不会立即发生。

transcript_json.text: First, the body must realize the muscles are damaged.
transcript_json.translation: 首先，身体必须意识到肌肉受到了损伤。

translations.zh-CN: 首先，身体必须意识到肌肉受到了损伤。

transcript_json.text: When the body realizes the muscles are hurt, the response is to increase blood flow to the area and increase body heat.
transcript_json.translation: 当身体意识到肌肉受伤时，反应是增加该区域的血流量并提高体温。

translations.zh-CN: 当身体意识到肌肉受伤时，反应是增加该区域的血流量并提高体温。

transcript_json.text: Damaged cells are then cleaned up and the body sends cells specially designed to break down the large muscle fibre fragments.
transcript_json.translation: 然后受损细胞被清理掉，身体会派出专门用来分解大型肌纤维碎片的细胞。

translations.zh-CN: 然后受损细胞被清理掉，身体会派出专门用来分解大型肌纤维碎片的细胞。

transcript_json.text: Healing can take place after this.
transcript_json.translation: 在这之后愈合才能发生。

translations.zh-CN: 在这之后愈合才能发生。

transcript_json.text: It takes about a day until these cells make it to your aching muscles.
transcript_json.translation: 这些细胞大约需要一天才能到达你酸痛的肌肉。

translations.zh-CN: 这些细胞大约需要一天才能到达你酸痛的肌肉。

transcript_json.text: That's why there's most often a delay associated with muscle soreness.
transcript_json.translation: 这就是为什么肌肉酸痛通常会有延迟。

translations.zh-CN: 这就是为什么肌肉酸痛通常会有延迟。

transcript_json.text: Repair of damaged cells takes about two days and afterwards the soreness disappears.
transcript_json.translation: 受损细胞的修复大约需要两天，之后酸痛就会消失。

translations.zh-CN: 受损细胞的修复大约需要两天，之后酸痛就会消失。

transcript_json.text: Unfortunately, there's little that can be done to relieve muscle soreness.
transcript_json.translation: 遗憾的是，几乎没有什么办法能缓解肌肉酸痛。

translations.zh-CN: 遗憾的是，几乎没有什么办法能缓解肌肉酸痛。

transcript_json.text: Pain relieving creams don't work, but a hot shower or warm bath can provide some relief.
transcript_json.translation: 止痛药膏不起作用，但热水淋浴或温水浴能提供一些缓解。

translations.zh-CN: 止痛药膏不起作用，但热水淋浴或温水浴能提供一些缓解。

Watching more than 3 hours of television a day doubles memory loss in older people. A new study of more than 3,000 adults suggests
transcript_json.translation: 每天看电视超过3小时会使老年人的记忆衰退加倍。一项针对3000多名成年人的新研究表明，

translations.zh-CN: 每天看电视超过3小时会使老年人的记忆衰退加倍。一项针对3000多名成年人的新研究表明，

transcript_json.text: Scientists at University College London used memory and fluency tests on the same group of people 6 years apart.
transcript_json.translation: 伦敦大学学院的科学家对同一组人相隔6年进行了记忆和语言流畅度测试。

translations.zh-CN: 伦敦大学学院的科学家对同一组人相隔6年进行了记忆和语言流畅度测试。

transcript_json.text: They found that those who watched on average less than 3 hours television a day showed a decline of around 4 to 5%, while those who tended to watch more than 3 hours a day declined by an average of 8 to 10%.
transcript_json.translation: 他们发现，平均每天看电视不到3小时的人，记忆力下降约4%到5%，而每天往往看3小时以上的人平均下降8%到10%。

translations.zh-CN: 他们发现，平均每天看电视不到3小时的人，记忆力下降约4%到5%，而每天往往看3小时以上的人平均下降8%到10%。

transcript_json.text: The research team say they believe the alert but passive nature of television watching may be creating stress on the mind, which contributes to memory decline.
transcript_json.translation: 研究团队表示，他们认为看电视时那种警觉却被动的状态可能给大脑造成压力，从而导致记忆衰退。

translations.zh-CN: 研究团队表示，他们认为看电视时那种警觉却被动的状态可能给大脑造成压力，从而导致记忆衰退。

transcript_json.text: Older people who watch more television are also less likely to undertake activities known to preserve mental functioning, such as reading or interactive screen-based pursuits, such as using the internet or playing video games.
transcript_json.translation: 看电视更多的老年人也更少从事已知有助于保持大脑功能的活动，比如阅读，或以屏幕互动为主的活动，如上互联网或玩电子游戏。

translations.zh-CN: 看电视更多的老年人也更少从事已知有助于保持大脑功能的活动，比如阅读，或以屏幕互动为主的活动，如上互联网或玩电子游戏。

transcript_json.text: The researchers say that television viewing may be a risk factor for Alzheimer's disease, but more research is needed to establish a link.
transcript_json.translation: 研究人员称，看电视可能是阿尔茨海默病的一个风险因素，但还需要更多研究来确定其中的关联。

translations.zh-CN: 研究人员称，看电视可能是阿尔茨海默病的一个风险因素，但还需要更多研究来确定其中的关联。

transcript_json.text: While watching television may have educational benefits and relaxation benefits, the researchers advise that adults over the age of 50 should try and ensure that television viewing is balanced with other contrasting activities.
transcript_json.translation: 虽然看电视可能有教育和放松方面的好处，但研究人员建议50岁以上的成年人应努力确保看电视与其他不同的活动保持平衡。

translations.zh-CN: 虽然看电视可能有教育和放松方面的好处，但研究人员建议50岁以上的成年人应努力确保看电视与其他不同的活动保持平衡。

transcript_json.text: If you're concerned that the amount of television you're watching could have a negative impact on your health, you should limit the amount of TV you watch each day and undertake some healthy hobbies.
transcript_json.translation: 如果你担心看电视的时长会对健康产生负面影响，就应该限制每天看电视的时间，并培养一些健康的爱好。

translations.zh-CN: 如果你担心看电视的时长会对健康产生负面影响，就应该限制每天看电视的时间，并培养一些健康的爱好。

transcript_json.text: One of the photos shows a thin film of clouds above the brilliant blue of the North Atlantic, cut by white lines of thicker clouds that look like scars.

Thanks to the International Space Station, we know quite a bit about the effects of low gravity on the human body, but NASA scientists want to learn more
transcript_json.translation: 多亏了国际空间站，我们对低重力对人体的影响了解了不少，但NASA的科学家想了解更多

translations.zh-CN: 多亏了国际空间站，我们对低重力对人体的影响了解了不少，但NASA的科学家想了解更多

transcript_json.text: To that end, they have been studying how other species deal with low gravity, specifically focusing on mice.
transcript_json.translation: 为此，他们一直在研究其他物种如何应对低重力，特别关注老鼠。

translations.zh-CN: 为此，他们一直在研究其他物种如何应对低重力，特别关注老鼠。

transcript_json.text: The results are both interesting and humorous.
transcript_json.translation: 结果既有趣又滑稽。

translations.zh-CN: 结果既有趣又滑稽。

transcript_json.text: The scientists first sent some mice, an especially designed cage, to the International Space Station.
transcript_json.translation: 科学家们首先把一些老鼠和一个专门设计的笼子送到了国际空间站。

translations.zh-CN: 科学家们首先把一些老鼠和一个专门设计的笼子送到了国际空间站。

transcript_json.text: The cage allowed them to study the behavior of the mice remotely from Earth via video.
transcript_json.translation: 这个笼子让他们可以通过视频从地球远程研究老鼠的行为。

translations.zh-CN: 这个笼子让他们可以通过视频从地球远程研究老鼠的行为。

transcript_json.text: As you'll notice in the video, the mice definitely seem uncomfortable at the beginning of the experiment.
transcript_json.translation: 正如你在视频中会注意到的，老鼠在实验开始时显然似乎很不舒服。

translations.zh-CN: 正如你在视频中会注意到的，老鼠在实验开始时显然似乎很不舒服。

transcript_json.text: They move around clumsily, drifting within the small confines of the cage, and do their best to figure out which way is up, but without success.
transcript_json.translation: 它们笨拙地四处移动，在笼子狭小的空间里飘浮，并尽力想弄清哪边是上，但没有成功。

translations.zh-CN: 它们笨拙地四处移动，在笼子狭小的空间里飘浮，并尽力想弄清哪边是上，但没有成功。

transcript_json.text: However, it's not long before the mice begin to catch on.
transcript_json.translation: 然而，没过多久老鼠就开始弄明白了。

translations.zh-CN: 然而，没过多久老鼠就开始弄明白了。

transcript_json.text: They adapt remarkably well to their new environment, and even use the lack of gravity to their advantage as they push themselves around the cage.
transcript_json.translation: 它们对新环境适应得非常好，甚至利用失重为自己谋利，在笼子里推着自己四处移动。

translations.zh-CN: 它们对新环境适应得非常好，甚至利用失重为自己谋利，在笼子里推着自己四处移动。

transcript_json.text: That's when things really get wild.
transcript_json.translation: 这时事情才真正变得疯狂。

translations.zh-CN: 这时事情才真正变得疯狂。

transcript_json.text: The 11th day of the experiment shows the mice are not just dealing with the gravity change, but actually seem to be enjoying it.
transcript_json.translation: 实验的第11天显示，老鼠不仅是在应对重力变化，而且似乎真的在享受它。

translations.zh-CN: 实验的第11天显示，老鼠不仅是在应对重力变化，而且似乎真的在享受它。

transcript_json.text: Several of the mice are observed running around the cage walls.
transcript_json.translation: 观察到有几只老鼠在笼壁周围跑动。

translations.zh-CN: 观察到有几只老鼠在笼壁周围跑动。

transcript_json.text: The scientists wanted to see whether the mice would continue doing the same kinds of activities they were observed doing on Earth.
transcript_json.translation: 科学家们想看看这些老鼠是否会继续做人们观察到的它们在地球上所做的那些活动。

translations.zh-CN: 科学家们想看看这些老鼠是否会继续做人们观察到的它们在地球上所做的那些活动。

transcript_json.text: The study showed that the mice kept much of their routines intact, including cleaning themselves, and eating when hungry.
transcript_json.translation: 研究表明，这些老鼠保持了大部分日常习惯，包括自我清洁，以及饿了就吃。

translations.zh-CN: 研究表明，这些老鼠保持了大部分日常习惯，包括自我清洁，以及饿了就吃。

transcript_json.text: The organization explains that this decision reflects general agreement among experts around the world that some people have a problem with these games.

It's easy to spend all day searching for inspiration. You can find incredible videos, articles, and news stories about the success of others

transcript_json.text: Every time you read an article or listen to an interview, you're practicing passive inspiration.

translations.zh-CN: 每当你读一篇文章或听一次访谈时，你都在实践被动式灵感。

transcript_json.text: You might learn something, but you don't actually have to do anything.
transcript_json.translation: 你或许学到了一些东西，但实际上你什么也不必做。

transcript_json.text: Our question today is why friends suddenly disappear.
transcript_json.translation: 我们今天的问题是，朋友为什么会突然消失。

translations.zh-CN: 我们今天的问题是，朋友为什么会突然消失。

transcript_json.text: They may block us on their social media accounts and stop responding to our emails.

transcript_json.text: They simply vanish without a trace.

translations.zh-CN: 他们就那样消失得无影无踪。

transcript_json.text: M: The answer may lie in childhood, the way the person related to their mom and dad.
transcript_json.translation: M: 答案也许在于童年，在于一个人与父母相处的方式。

translations.zh-CN: M: 答案也许在于童年，在于一个人与父母相处的方式。

transcript_json.text: There are two different attachment styles: an anxious attachment style and an avoidant attachment style.
transcript_json.translation: 有两种不同的依恋类型:焦虑型依恋和回避型依恋。

translations.zh-CN: 有两种不同的依恋类型:焦虑型依恋和回避型依恋。

transcript_json.text: When there is a relationship breakdown with their parents, children with an anxious attachment style scream and cry to get their parents to come back.
transcript_json.translation: 当与父母的关系破裂时,焦虑型依恋的孩子会 又哭又闹,想让父母回来。

transcript_json.text: But other children simply shut down and try to deal with their emotions by ignoring the situation.
transcript_json.translation: 但另一些孩子只是封闭自己,试图通过忽视这种情况来处理自己的情绪。

translations.zh-CN: 但另一些孩子只是封闭自己,试图通过忽视这种情况来处理自己的情绪。

transcript_json.text: And these attachment styles carry on into adulthood.
transcript_json.translation: 而这些 依恋类型会延续到成年期。

translations.zh-CN: 而这些 依恋类型会延续到成年期。

transcript_json.text: W: Does avoidance reduce their stress levels?
transcript_json.translation: W: 回避会降低他们的压力水平吗？

translations.zh-CN: W: 回避会降低他们的压力水平吗？

transcript_json.text: M: It's the same as conflicts.

translations.zh-CN: 和冲突的情况一样。

transcript_json.text: So if you have a disagreement with a securely attached person, they're not going to panic.
transcript_json.translation: 所以如果你和一个安全型依恋的人产生分歧,他们不会惊慌失措。

translations.zh-CN: 所以如果你和一个安全型依恋的人产生分歧,他们不会惊慌失措。

transcript_json.text: They're able to hear what the other person is saying and express their own feelings and thoughts effectively.

translations.zh-CN: 他们能够听进对 方在说什么,并有效地表达自己的感受和想法。

transcript_json.text: However, an insecurely attached person won't.

translations.zh-CN: 然而,不安全型依恋的人不会这样。

transcript_json.text: They might either attack you, get defensive, or just disappear from your life.

translations.zh-CN: 他们可能会攻击你,变得 防御性很强,或者直接从你的生活中消失。

transcript_json.text: To them, a difference, no matter how small in your eyes, signals the end of the relationship.

rtificial intelligence agents play ever more influential roles in our lives.
transcript_json.translation: 人工智能代理在我们的生活中扮演着越来越有影响力的角色。

transcript_json.text: They do everything from suggesting new friends to recommending purchases.

transcript_json.text: They're even beginning to drive our cars.

translations.zh-CN: 它们甚至开始驾驶我们的汽车。

transcript_json.text: Another role that they are expected to take over is negotiating on our behalf in commercial transactions or legal disputes.
transcript_json.translation: 它们预计将接管的另一个角色是在商业交易或法律纠纷中代表我们进 行谈判。

translations.zh-CN: 它们预计将接管的另一个角色是在商业交易或法律纠纷中代表我们进 行谈判。

transcript_json.text: So, it's important to know whether using an artificial intelligence agent might affect how we negotiate.
transcript_json.translation: 因此，了解使用人工智能代理是否会影响我们的谈判方式很重要。

translations.zh-CN: 因此，了解使用人工智能代理是否会影响我们的谈判方式很重要。

transcript_json.text: Research indicates that it does.
transcript_json.translation: 研究表明确实会。

translations.zh-CN: 研究表明确实会。

transcript_json.text: In a new study, participants were told to imagine that they were negotiating for something important to them, like a house.
transcript_json.translation: 在一项新研 究中，参与者被告知想象他们正在为对自己重要的东西进行谈判,比如一套房子。

translations.zh-CN: 在一项新研 究中，参与者被告知想象他们正在为对自己重要的东西进行谈判,比如一套房子。

transcript_json.text: Next they were told either that they would negotiate for themselves, or they would program an artificial intelligence agent to negotiate for them.
transcript_json.translation: 接下来他们被告知要么自 己谈判,要么编程一个人工智能代理代表他们谈判。

translations.zh-CN: 接下来他们被告知要么自 己谈判,要么编程一个人工智能代理代表他们谈判。

transcript_json.text: Participants then completed a survey indicating how tough, deceptive and pleasant or otherwise they wanted to be, or wanted their agent to be, in the negotiations.
transcript_json.translation: 然后参与者完成了一项调查,表明他们希望在谈判中表 现得多么强硬、多么具有欺骗性和多么令人愉快,或者希望他们的代理表现得如何。

translations.zh-CN: 然后参与者完成了一项调查,表明他们希望在谈判中表 现得多么强硬、多么具有欺骗性和多么令人愉快,或者希望他们的代理表现得如何。

transcript_json.text: For example, participants could choose to be tough by making an opening demand far greater than what they'd be willing to accept.
transcript_json.translation: 例如,参与者可以选择 通过提出远高于他们愿意接受的开价来表现强硬。

translations.zh-CN: 例如,参与者可以选择 通过提出远高于他们愿意接受的开价来表现强硬。

transcript_json.text: They could also choose to express sympathy with their opponent to appear pleasant.
transcript_json.translation: 他们也可以选择对对手表示同情以显得令人愉快。

translations.zh-CN: 他们也可以选择对对手表示同情以显得令人愉快。

transcript_json.text: But they could also indicate that they—or their agent—would strategically express anger toward the opponent to gain advantage, or they could opt to convey dissatisfaction with the encounter so that the other party would think they were losing interest.
transcript_json.translation: 但他 们也可以表示他们或他们的代理会策略性地向对手表达愤怒以获得优势,或者他们可以选择表达对这次接触 的不满,这样对方就会认为他们正在失去兴趣。

translations.zh-CN: 但他 们也可以表示他们或他们的代理会策略性地向对手表达愤怒以获得优势,或者他们可以选择表达对这次接触 的不满,这样对方就会认为他们正在失去兴趣。

transcript_json.text: These are both examples of deceptive strategies.
transcript_json.translation: 这些都是欺骗性策略的例子。

translations.zh-CN: 这些都是欺骗性策略的例子。

transcript_json.text: Participants were more willing to employ deceptive strategies when assigned an agent to negotiate on their behalf.

What is personal space?
transcript_json.translation: 什么是个人空间？

translations.zh-CN: 什么是个人空间？

transcript_json.text: We often think of it as an invisible bubble of space surrounding us that others can't enter without causing discomfort.
transcript_json.translation: 我们常把它看作环绕在我们周围的一个无形空间气泡，他人进入就会引起不适。

translations.zh-CN: 我们常把它看作环绕在我们周围的一个无形空间气泡，他人进入就会引起不适。

transcript_json.text: Research shows, however, that we actually have bubbles of different sizes.
transcript_json.translation: 然而，研究表明，我们实际上拥有大小不同的气泡。

translations.zh-CN: 然而，研究表明，我们实际上拥有大小不同的气泡。

transcript_json.text: Each of these bubbles applies to a different set of people.
transcript_json.translation: 每一个气泡都适用于不同的人群。

translations.zh-CN: 每一个气泡都适用于不同的人群。

transcript_json.text: The smallest zone, called intimate space, extends outward from our bodies 18 inches in every direction.
transcript_json.translation: 最小的区域称为亲密空间，从我们的身体向各个方向向外延伸 18 英寸。

translations.zh-CN: 最小的区域称为亲密空间，从我们的身体向各个方向向外延伸 18 英寸。

transcript_json.text: Only family, pets, and one's closest friends may enter it.
transcript_json.translation: 只有家人、宠物和最亲密的朋友可以进入。

translations.zh-CN: 只有家人、宠物和最亲密的朋友可以进入。

transcript_json.text: A mere acquaintance entering our intimate space makes us uncomfortable.
transcript_json.translation: 仅仅是一个熟人进入我们的亲密空间，就会让我们感到不适。

translations.zh-CN: 仅仅是一个熟人进入我们的亲密空间，就会让我们感到不适。

transcript_json.text: Next is the bubble called personal space, extending from 1.5 feet to 4 feet away.
transcript_json.translation: 接下来是称为个人空间的气泡，从 1.5 英尺延伸到 4 英尺远。

translations.zh-CN: 接下来是称为个人空间的气泡，从 1.5 英尺延伸到 4 英尺远。

transcript_json.text: Friends and acquaintances can comfortably occupy this zone, especially during informal conversations, but strangers are forbidden.
transcript_json.translation: 朋友和熟人可以自在地处于这一区域，尤其是在非正式交谈时，但陌生人则被排除在外。

translations.zh-CN: 朋友和熟人可以自在地处于这一区域，尤其是在非正式交谈时，但陌生人则被排除在外。

transcript_json.text: Extending from 4 to 12 feet away from us is social space.
transcript_json.translation: 从我们身边 4 到 12 英尺远的地方延伸出去的是社交空间。

translations.zh-CN: 从我们身边 4 到 12 英尺远的地方延伸出去的是社交空间。

transcript_json.text: Here people feel comfortable conducting routine social interactions with new acquaintances or total strangers.
transcript_json.translation: 在这里，人们可以自在地与新认识的人或完全陌生的人进行日常社交互动。

translations.zh-CN: 在这里，人们可以自在地与新认识的人或完全陌生的人进行日常社交互动。

transcript_json.text: Those are the average sizes of Americans' personal bubbles, anyway.
transcript_json.translation: 这些毕竟是美国人个人气泡的平均大小。

translations.zh-CN: 这些毕竟是美国人个人气泡的平均大小。

transcript_json.text: It is important to keep in mind that personal space varies depending on culture and context.
transcript_json.translation: 重要的是要记住，个人空间会因文化和情境而异。

translations.zh-CN: 重要的是要记住，个人空间会因文化和情境而异。

transcript_json.text: Furthermore, there are significant individual differences.
transcript_json.translation: 此外，个体之间也存在显著差异。

translations.zh-CN: 此外，个体之间也存在显著差异。

transcript_json.text: As we all know, cultural or individual differences in personal bubble diameters are all too often the cause of discomfort.
transcript_json.translation: 众所周知，个人气泡直径上的文化或个体差异往往是造成不适的原因。

translations.zh-CN: 众所周知，个人气泡直径上的文化或个体差异往往是造成不适的原因。

translations.zh-CN: 这些个人气泡是如何产生的？

transcript_json.text: According to research, we begin to develop our individual sense of personal space around age 3 or 4.

translations.zh-CN: 根据研究，我们在 3 岁或 4 岁左右开始形成个人的个人空间感。

transcript_json.text: The sizes of our bubbles are fixed by our teens.

translations.zh-CN: 我们的气泡大小在青少年时期就固定下来。

alking is unique to humans.

transcript_json.text: Researchers don't think language was invented; instead, they think it evolved.
transcript_json.translation: 研究人员认为语言不是被发明出来的,而是进化而来的。

transcript_json.text: How did talking evolve?
transcript_json.translation: 说话是如何 进化的?有两种主要理论。

translations.zh-CN: 说话是如何 进化的?有两种主要理论。

transcript_json.text: There are two main theories.
he first theory is that language started with people making different sounds, mostly imitating the things around them, like animal calls, nature sounds, and the sounds of tools.
transcript_json.translation: 第一种理论认为,语言起源于人们发出不同的声音,主要是模仿周围的事物,比如动物叫声、自然界的声音以 及工具的声音。

translations.zh-CN: 第一种理论认为,语言起源于人们发出不同的声音,主要是模仿周围的事物,比如动物叫声、自然界的声音以 及工具的声音。

transcript_json.text: Perhaps they made the sound of wind to comment on the weather or imitated the sound of a bird to tell a friend that there was a bird nearby.
transcript_json.translation: 也许他们发出风的声音来评论天气,或者模仿鸟叫声来告诉朋友附近有一只鸟。

translations.zh-CN: 也许他们发出风的声音来评论天气,或者模仿鸟叫声来告诉朋友附近有一只鸟。

transcript_json.text: Then over hundreds of thousands of years, those sounds turned into words that people began to learn as part of their language.
transcript_json.translation: 然后在数十 万年的时间里,这些声音演变成了词汇,人们开始将其作为语言的一部分来学习。

translations.zh-CN: 然后在数十 万年的时间里,这些声音演变成了词汇,人们开始将其作为语言的一部分来学习。

transcript_json.text: At some point, people started stringing the words together to form sentences.
transcript_json.translation: 在某个时刻,人们开始将词 汇串联起来形成句子。

translations.zh-CN: 在某个时刻,人们开始将词 汇串联起来形成句子。

transcript_json.text: he other main theory, which is more recent, is that people started off by gesturing—pointing at things with their hands and imitating actions using their bodies.
transcript_json.translation: 另一种主要理论更为近期,认为人们最初是通过手势——用手指向事物并用身体模仿动作来交流的。

translations.zh-CN: 另一种主要理论更为近期,认为人们最初是通过手势——用手指向事物并用身体模仿动作来交流的。

transcript_json.text: This theory guesses that after developing sign languages, people eventually started making sounds along with their gestures.
transcript_json.translation: 这个理论推测,在发展出手语之后,人们最终开始在做手势的同时发出声 音。

translations.zh-CN: 这个理论推测,在发展出手语之后,人们最终开始在做手势的同时发出声 音。

transcript_json.text: At some point, they switched to mostly making sounds that became words instead of just using their bodies.
transcript_json.translation: 在某个时刻,他们转变为主要发出声音形成词汇,而不仅仅是使用身体。

translations.zh-CN: 在某个时刻,他们转变为主要发出声音形成词汇,而不仅仅是使用身体。

transcript_json.text: The reason they switched to making sounds, the theory goes, is that talking out loud lets you communicate with someone even when you can't see them.
transcript_json.translation: 该理论认为,他们转向发出声音 的原因是,出声说话可以让你即使在看不见对方的情况下也能进行交流。

The new year has come and gone, and many may have already forgotten what they had resolved to do on January 1. But, if that resolution was to volunteer more, now is the best time to start
Volunteering can drop after the holiday season, and by February, some organisations lacked the volunteers they had in surplus just a month ago.
According to one survey, only 26% of Americans volunteer, despite reports that many Americans view volunteering as worthwhile.
Why such a disconnect?
Most people cite time and conflicting work schedules as major barriers.
But employees and employers would actually benefit if companies made employee volunteering part of the job.
Researchers have found donating our time and talent to others can lower blood pressure, boost happiness, and improve mental and physical health.
Studies have also linked employee volunteer programs with more productive employees.
With so much emphasis on employee wellness these days, company volunteer programs could be the perfect 2025 resolution.
But for volunteering to benefit employees and the workplace, the entire organization needs to be involved.

transcript_json.text: They found that elephants socialized more with each other during public feeding times.
transcript_json.translation: 他们发现大象在公开喂食时间彼此间的社交更多。

translations.zh-CN: 他们发现大象在公开喂食时间彼此间的社交更多。

transcript_json.text: After public feeding times, they were more likely to search for food and less likely to be inactive.

translations.zh-CN: 公开喂食时间之后，它们更可能去寻找食物，而不太可能一动不动。

Plastics have for years been used to make nearly everything that surrounds us
But along the way, they escaped the confines of packaging and objects and settled in the environment, the food we eat, and the air we breathe.
Americans are consuming and breathing in a lot of plastic.
transcript_json.translation: 多年来，塑料一直被用来制造我们周围几乎所有的东西

transcript_json.text: Based on available data, Americans take in an estimated 74,000 to 121,000 microplastic particles every year.
transcript_json.translation: 但在此过程中，它们摆脱了包装和物品的束缚，进入了环境、我们吃的食物和我们呼吸的空气中。

transcript_json.text: However, scientists believe the true number is probably much higher because for some likely sources of microplastics, there was no strong data available.

translations.zh-CN: 美国人正在摄入和吸入大量塑料。

transcript_json.text: Microplastics get into food and air in several ways.
transcript_json.translation: 根据现有数据，美国人每年摄入大约74000到121000个微塑料颗粒。

transcript_json.text: Many start off as part of larger plastic objects which over time fragment into smaller and smaller pieces until they become tiny, 5mm or less in diameter.
transcript_json.translation: 然而，科学家认为真实数字可能要高得多，因为对于一些可能的微塑料来源，没有强有力的可用数据。

Highly processed foods, the kind made with lots of sugar, fat, and salt, make up as much as 60% of the average American diet
transcript_json.translation: 高度加工食品，也就是用大量糖、脂肪和盐制成的那类食品，占普通美国人饮食的比例高达60%。

transcript_json.text: But a new study shows that their low price and convenience come at a cost to health.
transcript_json.translation: 但一项新研究表明，它们低廉的价格和便利是以健康为代价的。

translations.zh-CN: 但一项新研究表明，它们低廉的价格和便利是以健康为代价的。

transcript_json.text: The study found that, when people ate a highly processed diet, they consumed about 500 more calories per day than they did when they ate a less processed diet.
transcript_json.translation: 研究发现，人们吃高度加工饮食时，每天比吃加工程度较低的饮食时多摄入约500卡路里。

translations.zh-CN: 研究发现，人们吃高度加工饮食时，每天比吃加工程度较低的饮食时多摄入约500卡路里。

transcript_json.text: They also gained two pounds over two weeks, even though both diets had the same amounts of nutrients, like sugar, fat, fiber, and salt.
transcript_json.translation: 他们还在两周内增加了两磅体重，尽管两种饮食的糖、脂肪、纤维和盐等营养成分含量相同。

translations.zh-CN: 他们还在两周内增加了两磅体重，尽管两种饮食的糖、脂肪、纤维和盐等营养成分含量相同。

transcript_json.text: It wasn't a shock to find highly processed foods weren't healthy.
transcript_json.translation: 发现高度加工食品不健康并不令人意外。

translations.zh-CN: 发现高度加工食品不健康并不令人意外。

transcript_json.text: Other research has linked them to a higher risk of cancer and obesity.

transcript_json.text: What was unexpected was that sugar, fat, and salt didn't seem to be what caused people to overeat.
transcript_json.translation: 出乎意料的是，糖、脂肪和盐似乎并不是导致人们过量进食的原因。

translations.zh-CN: 出乎意料的是，糖、脂肪和盐似乎并不是导致人们过量进食的原因。

transcript_json.text: This is the first trial that demonstrates that there is something about highly processed foods independent of those nutrients that causes people to overeat.
transcript_json.translation: 这是首个试验证明，高度加工食品中有某种独立于这些营养成分的东西会导致人们过量进食。

translations.zh-CN: 这是首个试验证明，高度加工食品中有某种独立于这些营养成分的东西会导致人们过量进食。

transcript_json.text: The study also found that when eating a highly processed diet, people ate faster.
transcript_json.translation: 研究还发现，吃高度加工饮食时，人们吃得更快。

translations.zh-CN: 研究还发现，吃高度加工饮食时，人们吃得更快。

transcript_json.text: This could be one reason why they gained more weight.
transcript_json.translation: 这可能是他们体重增加更多的原因之一。

translations.zh-CN: 这可能是他们体重增加更多的原因之一。

transcript_json.text: Highly processed food tends to be softer, which makes it easier to chew and swallow.
transcript_json.translation: 高度加工食品往往更软，因此更容易咀嚼和吞咽。

transcript_json.text: One theory is that if you're eating more quickly, you're not giving your gut enough time to signal to your brain that you had enough calories and that you're full.
transcript_json.translation: 一种理论是，如果你吃得更快，就没有给肠道足够的时间向大脑发出信号，表明你已经摄入了足够的卡路里、已经饱了。

transcript_json.text: By the time the brain gets that signal, you've already overeaten.
transcript_json.translation: 等大脑接收到那个信号时，你已经吃多了。

translations.zh-CN: 等大脑接收到那个信号时，你已经吃多了。
